subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: The First Website at CERN
description: A micro-lesson that makes The First Website at CERN usable.

hook.text: On December 20, 1990, the world's first website went live at info.cern.ch.

buildup.text: It was plain text with blue hyperlinks explaining what the World Wide Web was.

discovery.text: No images, no design, no style. Just text describing how to use this new invention.

twist.text: The original page was lost for years. CERN launched a project in 2013 to restore it.

climax.text: That humble text page became the seed of an industry worth trillions of dollars.

punchline.text: The web's first page explained the web itself.

quiz.question: What was the first website about?
